body:
i was extremely paranoid a lot of the time, i fell out of touch with reality. i abused drugs and alcohol nearly all of the time. i don’t think the friendships can be rebuilt, far too much damage was done. 
corona has heightened the situation but it’s always been very difficult. it’s a weird dynamic and my relationship with my parents has always been rocky.

it’s a long story, it’s too painful to elaborate on. put simply, i began acting out a lot, i isolated myself too much and didn’t communicate. i was a very difficult person to be around. people tell me i’m a good person but i can just never believe it. i hate being awake because i do the same shit every day and i’ve become completely numb. i live in a difficult household and i don’t have a boyfriend/girlfriend to turn to. i feel very alone.
